West has no Q3 records, so there’s no like-for-like Q3 regional comparison. In Q4, East also has no records; West’s refund rate was 66.7% (4 of 6), 6.7 percentage points above East’s Q3 rate of 60%, though that is a cross-region, cross-quarter comparison.
